Gemini prompt #5: What are the best practices for designing scalable cloud microservices?

Gemini response #6: Scalable microservice architectures require deliberate isolation boundaries.

  • Decentralized data management per service
  • Circuit breaker pattern for fault isolation
  • Distributed tracing and structured telemetry
